Types & type chart

The type chart, and how Tallgrass plays matchups bigger than the main games.

Tallgrass uses the standard type chart, then plays it bigger: a super-effective hit is ×1.5 harder again and a resisted one ×0.6. So ×2 becomes ×3, ×4 becomes ×6, ×½ becomes ×0.3 and ×¼ ×0.15. Immunities stay ×0. Moves of your own type get the usual ×1.5 (STAB).

Matchups matter most against bosses, Gym Leaders and raid bosses. The Counter button in Party & PC builds a squad that hits the foe's weaknesses.
